newsitem.title: USA: Exxon, Texaco, Chevron say all settled Aramco tax.
newsitem.headline: Exxon, Texaco, Chevron say all settled Aramco tax.

text.p: Exxon Corp Texaco Inc and Chevron Corp said on Monday they settled disputes with the U.S. Internal Revenue Service over taxes on the sale of some Saudi Arabian crude some time ago.

Earlier, Mobil Corp said it expected to receive a total of $700 million in refunds from the IRS as a result of the IRS' failure to win a suit before the U.S. Supreme Court to overturn a lower court's verdict in favor of Texaco.
The IRS had claimed that Texaco should pay taxes on crude oil sales based on higher prices than the company received from 1979-1981.
Exxon said its claim had been decided in 1993, Chevron that the claim had been decided in August 1994 and Mobil that its claim had been decided two years ago. ((--New York Newsroom 212 859 1902))
